query: Which disclosure-risk thresholds (k-anonymity level, minimum cell sizes) and anonymization strategies (top/bottom coding, synthetic data, differential privacy) suit sharing deidentified student data?

response.query: Which disclosure-risk thresholds (k-anonymity level, minimum cell sizes) and anonymization strategies (top/bottom coding, synthetic data, differential privacy) suit sharing deidentified student data?
response.answer: For sharing deidentified student data, k-anonymity levels of 5 or higher and minimum cell sizes of 10 are recommended. Differential privacy and synthetic data are effective anonymization strategies.
